alex.w: Quick heads-up — ran a mixed-quota chaos run in staging (per-org + per-key + burst overrides). Saw ~1.3k 429s but org token counters didn't move. Anyone else see enforcement gaps?
jess: Link to run: https://internal.loadtests/1835123456 — 429s concentrated on keys with burst_enabled=true.
alex.w: logs snippet: ```[rl] request rejected org=org_42 key=key_9 reason=burst_exceeded``` but dashboard shows org.tokens_consumed flat during the window.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rl-enforcer-v2 deployed to staging at 2026-03-17T10:42Z
anika: If enforcer pre-checks and rejects before decrement, counters could look flat. But dashboard should still log rejected_attempts — I don't see that metric for this run.
lee: I can repro locally with the generator. Config I used: ```--org-mix 50:50 --keys 1000 --burst-prop 0.15 --qps 2000 --seed 54721``` — saw the same 429 cluster and a small latency spike.
jess: @lee can you upload the exact trace/replay to the run link? want to replay on the dedicated staging ring.
lee: Uploaded: https://internal.loadtests/1835123456/replay/54721. Also captured enforcer logs for the 30s window.
alex.w: Observations so far: 1) 429s correlated with keys that had burst_enabled but very low long-term quota 2) enforcer reports "burst_exceeded" but telemetry lacked a rejected_requests counter 3) RL enforcer latency briefly hit 150-220ms during peak.
anika: Actionable plan: I will add rl.enforcement.rejected_requests counter + rl.enforcement.precheck_latency histogram (tagged by org,key,env). ETA EOD.
jess: I'll add a temporary dashboard tile for 'rejected_requests' and surface per-key top offenders. Also bump retention for the loadtest traces to 7d.
lee: Quick note for load tests: please ramp no faster than 5%/30s when mixing per-key bursts — the generator's instant ramps can create artificial burst patterns that mask steady-state behavior.
alex.w: Sounds good. If telemetry change shows mismatched behavior we may need to flip the fallback to 'rate-limit-fail-open=false' on the canary. Will coordinate if needed.
jess: I'll run a follow-up with the patched enforcer and new telemetry on staging tomorrow morning. Ping me if you want in the run.
anika: I'll post the PR link once counters are added.
lee: thx — will run replay after PR merges. :+1:
